title: FBI Photo B2
what_is_it: A monochrome still image captured by a U.S. military sensor system, submitted by the FBI to AARO as a UAP report.
interpretation_warnings: The source text is almost entirely illegible due to extreme redaction and/or poor OCR extraction from a sensor image — nearly all readable text is garbled alphanumeric fragments from HUD overlays.
Most factual claims are drawn from the CSV metadata description rather than the document body itself, because the body text is unintelligible.
No mission report accompanied this image, so there is no narrative context from the operator.
The imagery was altered with redactions before AARO received it, meaning potentially identifying details were removed.
Single-source observation with no corroborating sensor data or witness accounts provided.
The date on the image is confirmed incorrect — the system clock was not set — so no precise date for the incident is available beyond 'late 2025'.

verifiable_claims.claim: The image date stamp reads 12/31/89 but the actual incident occurred in 2025, indicating the system clock was not set correctly.
